name: Met Office Weather DataHub
gives: site-specific and model forecasts and observations for the UK

why.quote: By ordering products from the Met Office Weather DataHub and clicking "confirm", you are agreeing to be bound by the Met Office Weather DataHub Terms and Conditions
why.basis: pricing page; the terms page itself (datahub.metoffice.gov.uk/terms) needs JavaScript and shows no terms text to our reader

interface: REST API with a key; plans by daily request limit (limits not read).
notes: waiting for a free key from Dinis. Accepting the terms and subscribing is Dinis's act, not ours.
how: Not collected yet. Decision by Dinis, 18 Nov 2026 about 22:20 UTC (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-london.md): London is the first place beyond Portugal; each UK source goes on the register with its terms read first, then is collected to the pipeline standard.
